read rec

A transcribed recipe reads, "
___________________________________________________________

Students of the Academy,
Students of the Academy, Welcome to New Archai.
What follows is a series of recipes and information meant to guide you into the world of the culinary arts, or for those less inclined to such pursuits - a way to feed yourselves at least.

Key ingredients that will benefit you in your early cooking are:

1) Salt
2) Meat
3) Herbs
4) Water
5) A foraged vegetable such as turnips, potatoes, carrots, corn.

**Author's Note: You may wish to store bundles of these ingredients in the depository to keep them from spoiling. Packets of 25, 50 or 100 make for ease of use when learning how to cook.

----Three Chapters of Cuisine, a Beginner's Guide to Pearlean Gastronomy----
By Emissary Faran Fairuz-Taqqi, Khalsat of Kaleith

**Author's Note: Salt is easily found by mining in the Orc Caves of the academy, located to the west outside of the south gate up along the Highland Road. Meat, and other bits,  can be skinned from the animals residing in the Tallwood Forest, located south and east outside of the south gate. Vegetables, herbs, rice and other accoutrements may be foraged in the Tallwood as well, or likewise foraged in the farmlands to the northeast of the woods.

----Chapter 1----

1.Butter
**Author’s Note: Useful in a number of advanced recipes, butter will become a staple in the more accessible cuisine of boiled corn, scrambled eggs and sauteed mushrooms.
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 cup milk and 1 pinch of salt into a pot, bring to boil and then let rest.

2. Boiled potatoes
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 pound potatoes and 1 spring herbs in a pot.

3. Boiled carrots
To prepare: Boil 1 pound carrots in 10 cups of water with 1 spring of herbs.

4. Boiled turnips
To prepare: Boil 1 cup turnips in 10 cups of water with 1 sprig of herbs.

5.Cooked Beans
To prepare: Boil 1 cup beans with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

6. Hardboiled egg
**Author's Note: Eggs can be purchased from the Butcher's Daughter in Hawker's Alley of the Academy, or coerced from chickens in the farmlands of Dalarey in Pearl.
To prepare: Boil 1 egg with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

7. Boiled meat
**Author's Note: This recipe is one of the easiest to make, given its ingredients, and will aid in learning advanced techniques.
To prepare: Boil 1 pound meat with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

8. Rabbit stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of rabbit meat with 1 cup of potatoes and 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 2----

9. Boiled corn
To prepare: Boil 1 ear of corn in 10 cups of water, adding 1 stick of butter for flavor.

10. Vegetable soup
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes and 1 cup of corn in 10 cups of water.

11. Boiled rice
**Authors Note: Another easy and quick recipe, due to the abudance of forageable salt and rice in the Academy.
To prepare: Boil 1 cup rice with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 3----

12. Scrambled eggs
To prepare: Fry 2 eggs with 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 pinch of salt.
**Author's Note: Remember to EMPTY your pot of water before placing your ingredients in to cook. You can FILL your pot from a water source (Shattered Lake, wells, fountains and even your waterskin at a later time).

13. Boiled quail
To prepare: Poach 1 quail breast in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

14. Boiled chicken
To prepare: Poach 1 breast of chicken in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

15. Beef stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 pound of meat in 10 cups of water with 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes, 1 cup corn and 1 cup of tomatoes for a hearty, robust meal.

Have fun exploring the many locales around you to forage, dig, and collect useful ingredients for your culinary adventure.

Fair tides and majestic mastication,
~Faran


___________________________________________________________
"

[Entranceway Foyer.]

[Entranceway Foyer.]

An ornate door creaks loudly as it sways back and forth on its hinges.  The light breeze coming through does little to hinder the sour stench of decay.  The cobwebs hanging across the corners, windowpanes, and pictures along the wall sway ever so slightly.  Both the entrance-way and the hallway have been tiled using small slabs of marble, but the stone floorings have since loosened and cracked.  Most of the damage can be found beneath the shattered windows down the hallway on the western side.  Deep-red blood drips down from the ceiling near the long, eastern wall.  It puddles on the floor and seeps along the tiles' cracks.  A pair of glowing sconces hang on the wall.  You notice a broken oak door.

What had once been plush carpet has now been soiled and matted.  Wallpaper has separated from the walls near the ceiling, but as evidenced by the cobwebs, it has not been peeling recently.  Large chairs and couches have been covered with sheets.  The tables between them are coated thick with dust.  Bookshelves and decrepit cabinets contain ravaged books and damaged boxes of old puzzles and games.  The flame-darkened fireplace rests within the northern wall.  To the right is a hallway with a large stairwell leading up to the second floor.  A couple glowing sconces illuminate the room.  You notice a darkened stone fireplace.

Obvious Exits: west, and east.

[Lobby.]

Judging by the service counter along the eastern wall, this looks to have been the lobby for which the afflicted were admitted.  Shattered windows adorn the outer wall, the drapes faded and brittle.  Sheets cover most of the furniture between the windows, but some of the sheets have been removed, revealing antique couches and chairs that have been abused and torn.  The patterned marble-tiled floor, which continues down the hallway to the north, is concaved in some places.  A couple glowing sconces illuminate the room.

Obvious Exits: east, and north.

[Entranceway Foyer.]

An ornate door creaks loudly as it sways back and forth on its hinges.  The light breeze coming through does little to hinder the sour stench of decay.  The cobwebs hanging across the corners, windowpanes, and pictures along the wall sway ever so slightly.  Both the entrance-way and the hallway have been tiled using small slabs of marble, but the stone floorings have since loosened and cracked.  Most of the damage can be found beneath the shattered windows down the hallway on the western side.  Deep-red blood drips down from the ceiling near the long, eastern wall.  It puddles on the floor and seeps along the tiles' cracks.  A pair of glowing sconces hang on the wall.  You notice a broken oak door.

Obvious Exits: south.

A wrought iron lantern casts an illuminating glow over the street.  A towering stone wall extends in opposite directions from a heavy steel gate with thick steel bars making up its width.  The gate has been heavily reinforced to keep out potential invaders.  You notice a closed heavy reinforced oak door, and an open large steel gate.

Obvious Exits: north. 

Flynt flies in from the north.



[Academy Gateway.]

Towering stone walls leading in from the east and west turn sharply toward the north where they are joined by a large steel gate.  Above, guards can be seen patrolling along either side of the gate, constantly monitoring the steady flow of traffic into and out of the academy.  You notice an open large steel gate, and a weathered wooden sign with the word "WARNING" boldly engraved.

Obvious Exits: south. 

Flynt flies in through a large steel gate.



[Southland Intersection.]

The maintained roads of the academy proper come to an end where the street intersects with several pathways that provide access to the various hunting grounds that surround the area.  An iron gate stands to the south, a sign has been affixed to its detailed metalwork that warns against trespassing.  Massive trees beyond the gate block any view of what lies within.  A tall, white tower can be seen in the northern sky.  You notice an open intricately detailed iron gate, and a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, and north. 

Flynt flies in from the north.



[Phantom Lane, Gate.]

Overgrown grass and weeds line either side of the cobblestone road.  The gate that quarantines this area has been engraved with hundreds of angelic figures which all appear to be fleeing in the same northern direction.  A rusty sewer grate sits to the side of the road, below the gate.  Trees block much of the view beyond the vegetation.  Besides the wind rustling the trees, an eerie silence engulfs the route.  You notice an open rusty iron sewer grate, and an open intricately detailed iron gate.

Obvious Exits: south. 

Flynt flies in through an intricately detailed iron gate.



[Phantom Lane.]

The large dark-gray wooden manor sticks out from atop the trees in the distance to the southeast.  The cobblestone road is hardly visible beneath the dense grass and weeds. [Phantom Lane.]

read rec

A transcribed recipe reads, "
___________________________________________________________

Students of the Academy,
Students of the Academy, Welcome to New Archai.
What follows is a series of recipes and information meant to guide you into the world of the culinary arts, or for those less inclined to such pursuits - a way to feed yourselves at least.

Key ingredients that will benefit you in your early cooking are:

1) Salt
2) Meat
3) Herbs
4) Water
5) A foraged vegetable such as turnips, potatoes, carrots, corn.

**Author's Note: You may wish to store bundles of these ingredients in the depository to keep them from spoiling. Packets of 25, 50 or 100 make for ease of use when learning how to cook.

----Three Chapters of Cuisine, a Beginner's Guide to Pearlean Gastronomy----
By Emissary Faran Fairuz-Taqqi, Khalsat of Kaleith

**Author's Note: Salt is easily found by mining in the Orc Caves of the academy, located to the west outside of the south gate up along the Highland Road. Meat, and other bits,  can be skinned from the animals residing in the Tallwood Forest, located south and east outside of the south gate. Vegetables, herbs, rice and other accoutrements may be foraged in the Tallwood as well, or likewise foraged in the farmlands to the northeast of the woods.

----Chapter 1----

1.Butter
**Author’s Note: Useful in a number of advanced recipes, butter will become a staple in the more accessible cuisine of boiled corn, scrambled eggs and sauteed mushrooms.
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 cup milk and 1 pinch of salt into a pot, bring to boil and then let rest.

2. Boiled potatoes
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 pound potatoes and 1 spring herbs in a pot.

3. Boiled carrots
To prepare: Boil 1 pound carrots in 10 cups of water with 1 spring of herbs.

4. Boiled turnips
To prepare: Boil 1 cup turnips in 10 cups of water with 1 sprig of herbs.

5.Cooked Beans
To prepare: Boil 1 cup beans with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

6. Hardboiled egg
**Author's Note: Eggs can be purchased from the Butcher's Daughter in Hawker's Alley of the Academy, or coerced from chickens in the farmlands of Dalarey in Pearl.
To prepare: Boil 1 egg with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

7. Boiled meat
**Author's Note: This recipe is one of the easiest to make, given its ingredients, and will aid in learning advanced techniques.
To prepare: Boil 1 pound meat with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

8. Rabbit stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of rabbit meat with 1 cup of potatoes and 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 2----

9. Boiled corn
To prepare: Boil 1 ear of corn in 10 cups of water, adding 1 stick of butter for flavor.

10. Vegetable soup
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes and 1 cup of corn in 10 cups of water.

11. Boiled rice
**Authors Note: Another easy and quick recipe, due to the abudance of forageable salt and rice in the Academy.
To prepare: Boil 1 cup rice with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 3----

12. Scrambled eggs
To prepare: Fry 2 eggs with 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 pinch of salt.
**Author's Note: Remember to EMPTY your pot of water before placing your ingredients in to cook. You can FILL your pot from a water source (Shattered Lake, wells, fountains and even your waterskin at a later time).

13. Boiled quail
To prepare: Poach 1 quail breast in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

14. Boiled chicken
To prepare: Poach 1 breast of chicken in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

15. Beef stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 pound of meat in 10 cups of water with 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes, 1 cup corn and 1 cup of tomatoes for a hearty, robust meal.

Have fun exploring the many locales around you to forage, dig, and collect useful ingredients for your culinary adventure.

Fair tides and majestic mastication,
~Faran


___________________________________________________________
"

A transcribed recipe reads, "
___________________________________________________________

Students of the Academy,
Students of the Academy, Welcome to New Archai.
What follows is a series of recipes and information meant to guide you into the world of the culinary arts, or for those less inclined to such pursuits - a way to feed yourselves at least.

Key ingredients that will benefit you in your early cooking are:

1) Salt
2) Meat
3) Herbs
4) Water
5) A foraged vegetable such as turnips, potatoes, carrots, corn.

**Author's Note: You may wish to store bundles of these ingredients in the depository to keep them from spoiling. Packets of 25, 50 or 100 make for ease of use when learning how to cook.

----Three Chapters of Cuisine, a Beginner's Guide to Pearlean Gastronomy----
By Emissary Faran Fairuz-Taqqi, Khalsat of Kaleith

**Author's Note: Salt is easily found by mining in the Orc Caves of the academy, located to the west outside of the south gate up along the Highland Road. Meat, and other bits,  can be skinned from the animals residing in the Tallwood Forest, located south and east outside of the south gate. Vegetables, herbs, rice and other accoutrements may be foraged in the Tallwood as well, or likewise foraged in the farmlands to the northeast of the woods.

----Chapter 1----

1.Butter
**Author’s Note: Useful in a number of advanced recipes, butter will become a staple in the more accessible cuisine of boiled corn, scrambled eggs and sauteed mushrooms.
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 cup milk and 1 pinch of salt into a pot, bring to boil and then let rest.

2. Boiled potatoes
To prepare: Mix 10 cups water, 1 pound potatoes and 1 spring herbs in a pot.

3. Boiled carrots
To prepare: Boil 1 pound carrots in 10 cups of water with 1 spring of herbs.

4. Boiled turnips
To prepare: Boil 1 cup turnips in 10 cups of water with 1 sprig of herbs.

5.Cooked Beans
To prepare: Boil 1 cup beans with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

6. Hardboiled egg
**Author's Note: Eggs can be purchased from the Butcher's Daughter in Hawker's Alley of the Academy, or coerced from chickens in the farmlands of Dalarey in Pearl.
To prepare: Boil 1 egg with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

7. Boiled meat
**Author's Note: This recipe is one of the easiest to make, given its ingredients, and will aid in learning advanced techniques.
To prepare: Boil 1 pound meat with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

8. Rabbit stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of rabbit meat with 1 cup of potatoes and 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 2----

9. Boiled corn
To prepare: Boil 1 ear of corn in 10 cups of water, adding 1 stick of butter for flavor.

10. Vegetable soup
To prepare: Slow cook 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes and 1 cup of corn in 10 cups of water.

11. Boiled rice
**Authors Note: Another easy and quick recipe, due to the abudance of forageable salt and rice in the Academy.
To prepare: Boil 1 cup rice with 1 pinch of salt in 10 cups of water.

----Chapter 3----

12. Scrambled eggs
To prepare: Fry 2 eggs with 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 pinch of salt.
**Author's Note: Remember to EMPTY your pot of water before placing your ingredients in to cook. You can FILL your pot from a water source (Shattered Lake, wells, fountains and even your waterskin at a later time).

13. Boiled quail
To prepare: Poach 1 quail breast in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

14. Boiled chicken
To prepare: Poach 1 breast of chicken in 10 cups of water, adding 1 sprig of herbs for aromatics and flavor.

15. Beef stew
To prepare: Slow cook 1 pound of meat in 10 cups of water with 1 cup of carrots, 1 cup of potatoes, 1 cup corn and 1 cup of tomatoes for a hearty, robust meal.

Have fun exploring the many locales around you to forage, dig, and collect useful ingredients for your culinary adventure.

Fair tides and majestic mastication,
~Faran


___________________________________________________________
"

[City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk.  The base of the centerpiece rests at the bottom of a shallow fountain that has a burning spear pointing down into the water.  A small stone sundial has been carved on the rim of the fountain.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, northwest, northeast, west, east, and north.
